method: One row per item of docs/parity/inventory-mgmt.json (923), same order, same ids (never invented or reworded). Per item the APK side was taken from the inventory's details/apk_refs (re-read in android/jadx-out where the details left the behaviour open, e.g. ProjectDebugViewModel -> domain/interactors/cloud/DisableSync, force_update_activity.xml for update_jung_home, ProvisionedBaseMeshNode.security for HIGH/LOW) and compared with custom_components/junghome_ble (+ jhmesh) and tools/. Lookup per id kind: cfgop:<hex> / proxyop / appop -> the opcode constant and its builder / decoder in jhmesh/config_messages.py, jhmesh/pdu.py (proxy_config_*, FILTER_*), jhmesh/messages.py (TIME_*, HEALTH_*), then its production callers (grep -rn '<builder>(' in commission.py, onboarding.py, audit.py, mesh_config.py, coordinator.py, tools/cli_ops.py); const:<Class>.<NAME> -> the equivalent constant or check in pdu.py / client.py / crypto.py / config_messages.py (SEGMENT_SIZE, UNSEGMENTED_UPPER_*, NONCE_*, proxy_frame / ProxyReassembler, parse_beacon, parse_lower, _on_segment timers); gatt:<uuid> -> grep -rni '<uuid>' (only 0x1827/0x2ADB/0x2ADC and 0x1828/0x2ADD/0x2ADE exist; DIS / Silabs OTA / JUNG characteristics have no hit); prov*: -> jhmesh/provisioning.py; model:<hex4> -> commission.CONFIG_MODELS / BIND_LIST, coordinator Health / Time use, tools/mesh_report.SIG_MODELS; api:<class>.<method> and nordic:<Class>.<method> -> the HA/jhmesh function doing the same job (ProxyClient, LocalState, ProjectFile, Vault, CDB, provisioning); flow:/err:/setup:/timing: -> the HA flow doing that job (onboard.async_add_device + commission.plan + onboarding.commission for provisioning/ConfigureDevice, mesh_config.remove_node for ResetDevice, coordinator._connection_loop / _after_connect / _refresh_all / _send_time for ConnectToProxy / LoadInitialDeviceState, keep_awake.py, client.set_filter / _resend_filter) and its constants in const.py / client.py / provisioning.py; builder: -> the builder function(s) only; debug: -> the CLI sub-command (tools/mesh_poc.py build_parser, tools/cli_ops.py), HA action (services.yaml) or diagnostics doing the same; fw*: -> grep for update.json / gbl / OTA / storage schema (no hit: review-3 N9 not started); str:<name> -> the strings.json key (exceptions/issues/entity) that tells the user the same thing, else the flow the text belongs to; pref:/time:/krphase:/timerole:/battery:/versioncmp:/misc -> by the mechanism named in the details. Where docs/parity/ledger-msg.json or ledger-prop.json already judged the same opcode / property the judgement was re-checked against the current code and kept consistent (e.g. prop:sig:0x0010 partial -> builder:manufacturerhardwarerevisionmessagebuilder partial). code: 'path:line' resolved mechanically from a symbol (def / class / assignment / JSON key, or a regex for table rows) against the current tree, so line numbers follow the code. tests: names resolved against an AST index of every def test_* in tests/**/test_*.py (1851 functions) and chosen by reading the test body (the test must call the builder / flow or assert its wire bytes, text or effect). Status rules: implemented = the app's behaviour (encoding, ranges, order, timing or a documented better superset, explained in 'note') with code and at least one exercising test; partial = code exists but part of the behaviour, a value, a timing or a test is missing ('missing' says exactly what); gap = no code doing it ('missing' + 'feasibility': 'yes offline' = implementable and verifiable with unit tests / tests/sim / fake BLE clients, 'needs the installation' = the decisive fact needs a capture or a device class the installation lacks); na = no behaviour to reproduce, with the design constraint in 'reason' (Nordic name-only Mesh 1.1 models, JUNG cloud / Android permission / app-store features, empty stubs, BlueZ/ESPHome exposing no connection priority). NOT-USED library capability (inventory 'NOT USED') is judged like everything else: implemented when we have it (heartbeats, Health), gap when not (Friend, LPN, NetKey Get/List, Node Identity, virtual addresses), so 'better than the app' is visible. A rerun reproduces this by walking the same inventory ids with the same lookups; only code changes (new builders / flows / tests) should change a status. VERIFICATION: every code path:line and test id re-resolved (0 dangling); gap/partial/na rows re-searched with broader greps (other names, other modules, HA platforms, tools/, tests/sim) - none turned out implemented; status consistency rule applied: when an item's inventory details name a behaviour that another row already judges missing, the item cannot be implemented (provfail:09, flow:deviceprovisioning -> partial). Rows appended after the generated block judge the inventory items added by its verification sweep (groups 18-22), by the same lookups. Citations: every `code` entry is now `path::symbol` (docs/parity/README.md, Row schema), converted from `path:line` by reading each line in the tree its ledger line was written against (git blame), following it through every later re-pointing that kept the cited text and past the merges that re-pointed lines to other code, and naming the innermost symbol holding it; `tools/parity.py check` verifies each symbol is defined.
